name: building-turn-farm
description: the farm hhou (player 1) box selected alone at (3136, -1024) of edge-last-step.w3m (make-building-turn-input.mjs; the camera and box of edge-single-diagonal), KP_8 (the nudge shows it is selected), then KP_Multiply 3 times: it moves 64 and stays at 270. The editor's turn keys leave buildings at their facing; Studio: index.ts rotateSelected skips unit types with a pathing texture (branch we-compare-9)

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.units?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-tab')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Select').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__key = async (k, code) => { const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: k, code, bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 40)); };
